helpers.cm_get:
def cm_get(xs, i)
  raise IndexError, 'index out of range' unless i >= 0 && i < xs.length
  xs[i]
end
helpers.cm_modinv:
def cm_modinv(a, m)
  n = m.abs
  r0, r1 = a % n, n
  s0, s1 = 1, 0
  while r1 != 0
    q = r0 / r1
    r0, r1 = r1, r0 - q * r1
    s0, s1 = s1, s0 - q * s1
  end
  raise ZeroDivisionError, "base is not invertible" if r0 != 1
  s0 % n
end
helpers.cm_powmod:
def cm_powmod(a, b, m)
  if b < 0
    a = cm_modinv(a, m)
    b = -b
  end
  a.pow(b, m)
end
helpers.cm_s_at:
def cm_s_at(s, i)
  raise IndexError, 'string index out of range' if i < 0 || i >= s.length
  s[i].ord
end
helpers.cm_s_chr:
def cm_s_chr(c)
  raise RangeError, 'not a Unicode scalar value' if c < 0 || c > 0x10FFFF || (c >= 0xD800 && c <= 0xDFFF)
  c.chr(Encoding::UTF_8)
end
helpers.cm_s_clamp:
def cm_s_clamp(i, n)
  i += n if i < 0
  i < 0 ? 0 : (i > n ? n : i)
end
helpers.cm_s_find:
def cm_s_find(s, sub, start)
  n = s.length
  i = start < 0 ? [start + n, 0].max : start
  return -1 if i > n
  r = s.index(sub, i)
  r.nil? ? -1 : r
end
helpers.cm_s_ord:
def cm_s_ord(s)
  raise TypeError, 'ord of a string whose length is not 1' if s.length != 1
  s.ord
end
helpers.cm_s_slice:
def cm_s_slice(s, a, b)
  n = s.length
  lo = cm_s_clamp(a, n)
  hi = cm_s_clamp(b, n)
  lo < hi ? s[lo, hi - lo] : ''
end
helpers.cm_s_to_int:
def cm_s_to_int(s)
  t = s.gsub(/\A[ \t\n\r\x0b\x0c]+|[ \t\n\r\x0b\x0c]+\z/, '')
  raise ArgumentError, 'not a decimal integer' unless t =~ /\A[+-]?[0-9]+\z/
  t.to_i
end
helpers.cm_set:
def cm_set(xs, i, v)
  raise IndexError, 'index out of range' unless i >= 0 && i < xs.length
  xs[i] = v
end
